units.source_text: 古歌：“一面匆匆见，依稀看不真。

en.t: An old poem says: I caught only one hurried glimpse of your face, so faintly that I could not see it clearly.

units.source_text: 不知缘底事，想望到如今。”

en.t: I do not know what bond brought this about, yet I have longed for you down to this very day.
It is found in The Tales of Ise.
